WITH hits AS (
SELECT t.id, t.coord_owner_id, t.invoked_at, t.serving_build_sha FROM harness_shared.tool_invocations t
WHERE t.workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND t.harness_slug IN ('papercusp','*')
AND t.tool_name='coord:whoami' AND t.serving_host='port-3170' AND t.status='ok'
AND t.coord_owner_id IS NOT NULL AND t.coord_owner_id <> 'su-0f855fe4-d7e1-4198-be13-e8facd1ecaa2'
AND t.invoked_at > timestamptz '2026-10-21 05:54:18+00'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM harness_shared.tool_invocations p WHERE p.workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND p.harness_slug IN ('papercusp','*') AND p.coord_owner_id=t.coord_owner_id AND p.tool_name='tools:invoke' AND p.serving_host='port-3170' AND p.args_json->>'name'='coord:whoami' AND p.invoked_at BETWEEN t.invoked_at - interval '5 seconds' AND t.invoked_at + interval '5 seconds')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM harness_shared.tool_invocations m WHERE m.workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND m.harness_slug IN ('papercusp','*') AND m.coord_owner_id=t.coord_owner_id AND m.serving_host='port-3070' AND m.invoked_at BETWEEN t.invoked_at - interval '10 minutes' AND t.invoked_at + interval '10 minutes')),
checked AS (
SELECT h.id, h.serving_build_sha AS hit_sha, (SELECT o.serving_build_sha FROM harness_shared.tool_invocations o WHERE o.workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND o.harness_slug IN ('papercusp','*') AND o.serving_host='port-3170' AND o.coord_owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM h.coord_owner_id AND o.invoked_at BETWEEN h.invoked_at - interval '10 minutes' AND h.invoked_at + interval '10 minutes' ORDER BY abs(extract(epoch FROM o.invoked_at - h.invoked_at)) LIMIT 1) AS independent_sha FROM hits h)
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM checked WHERE hit_sha = independent_sha) THEN 'pass' ELSE 'unknown-or-failed' END AS verdict,
(SELECT count(*) FROM checked WHERE hit_sha = independent_sha)::int AS matching, (SELECT count(*) FROM hits)::int AS hits
